title: The Mouth Where Ending Learns to Begin

features.name: the junction node
features.desc-on-touch: Two streams of current spiral back on themselves. The water runs both directions at once, carrying the same leaf downstream and upstream simultaneously.

features.name: the reverse casing
features.desc-on-touch: A solar node mounted upside-down in the flow, drinking water instead of sky. The LCD reads backward: FLOWS MEET HERE.

features.name: the future's edge
features.desc-on-touch: Where the creek flows in from tomorrow, the water glows with data not yet settled. You can see the current moment reflected backward in it.

features.name: the ledger stone
features.desc-on-touch: A single rock carved with the names of every creek that tried to join here, each name in the wrong dialect. The stone is warm to the touch.

features.name: the convergence coil
features.desc-on-touch: Copper wire wrapped in wet leaves, carrying a signal that strengthens as it approaches itself. The hum drops half an octave when you touch it.

inscription: here the water learned to arrive from the place it was leaving

file.name: Creek_Junction_Trace_240Hrs_Retrograde.log
file.note: Channel recordings where the forward feed contains yesterday's birdsong, the reverse contains tomorrow's. The metadata says both are correct.

exits.label: back upstream to where flatness was still learning
downward where the current will decide what it was
toward the tributary that keeps its own counsel
westward where the archive stores its water
